findings.title: Microsoft 365 Status: maintenance activity impacted Microsoft Teams in Asia-Pacific
findings.summary_md: Microsoft's official Microsoft 365 Status account stated that maintenance-related activity had an unintended impact on the Microsoft Teams service, degrading functionality for users in the Asia-Pacific region. The company said it halted the maintenance and that service returned to standard availability levels, with further details available in the admin center under incident TM1461801.

findings.title: ITmedia NEWS: Microsoft Teams trouble joining meetings from the morning
findings.summary_md: Japanese outlet ITmedia reported that Microsoft Teams users were unable to join meetings from the morning of August 26, 2026. The post shared the outlet's coverage as reports of the issue spread on X.

findings.title: Microsoft Teams Suffers Widespread Outage Affecting Meetings and Collaboration Features
findings.summary_md: VYPR reported that a Microsoft Teams outage beginning around 9:00 a.m. local time in Japan prevented users from joining or creating meetings and hindered screen sharing, while one-to-one calls remained available. Microsoft's first official update was posted at 6:56 a.m. IST and a final advisory at 7:26 a.m. IST said the issue was largely mitigated; the root cause was attributed to maintenance activity.

findings.title: Cyber Security News: Microsoft Teams Outage Largely Mitigated
findings.summary_md: Cyber Security News shared that Microsoft confirmed customers may have been unable to use multiple Microsoft Teams features and that the latest customer note at 7:26 a.m. IST on August 26, 2026 said the issue was largely mitigated, with monitoring to continue for 15 to 30 minutes.
